messages:
Olivia Chen: FYI — Finance is asking for formal sign-off on new GPU reservations for eu-north-1 to cover Q3/Q4 NMT + embeddings capacity. We need: committed hours, expected util, 1yr vs 3yr delta, and any billing anomalies from last invoice. Can infra ops assemble a proposal by EOD Fri? cc @Sasha Patel
Marcus Li: On it. Quick note — embeddings traffic in eu-north has grown fast; current GPU pool sits ~80% daytime. Do we have a target uplift? +20%? Also, I spotted a billing oddity: a spike in "networkinterconnect charges" on the last invoice. :thinking_face:
Sasha Patel: From finance side we need: committed vs on-demand delta, recommended term (1yr v 3yr), payback period. Finance prefers 1yr unless 3yr yields >15% savings. Also need proof that VMs/GPU SKUs are tagged to cost center "ml-prod" before we approve.
Devon Brooks: We can structure a 1yr convertible commit with burst capacity to handle peaks. Region note: eu-north1 has constrained H100 availability — may need a mixed plan (H100 reserved + A100 flex). I'll pull inventory/perf profiles and SKU mappings.
Marcus Li: I'll put together utilization snapshots + 6m forecast. Preliminary ask: +6 H100-equivalent for 1yr. Also digging into that egress billing spike — suspect model-sync jobs hitting s3-eu-west by mistake.
Anna Müller: Confirming — there was a k8s cronjob that syncs checkpoints nightly to s3-eu-west instead of s3-eu-north. Investigating rollback and will open PR to fix. This likely explains the cross-region egress charges. :face_with_head_bandage:
CostBot: [automated] Cost anomaly detected for account: redwood-prod. Query cb-20260314-77. Monthly egress spike +€12,430. Top contributors: model-sync (45%), snapshot-backups (30%), misc transfers (25%).
Olivia Chen: OK — action items: Marcus: forecast + utilization and populate the commit request template. Devon: propose commit mix (H100 vs A100) + availability risk and SKU mapping. Anna: root cause and mitigation for egress (include estimated retroactive charges). Sasha: draft approval language for FinOps (deadline Tue next week). If we can get the proposal doc before Mon EOD I'll loop Legal for contract review.
Marcus Li: Quick preview numbers to save time:
```
Current reserved: 18 H100-equivalent
Daytime util: 78% (last 30d)
Suggested 1yr add: +6 H100-eq (sustained)
Suggested 3yr add: +10 H100-eq (lower unit price)
Estimated savings: 1yr ~21% vs on-demand, 3yr ~30% vs on-demand
Estimated monthly commit cost delta (1yr): ~€48k additional capex vs variable spend reduced by ~€60k/mo -> payback ~0.8 months (on steady-state)
```
Sasha Patel: That draft looks reasonable. Please also confirm the reserved SKUs support spot bursting and how unused reserved capacity is billed (unused vs convertible credits). We need those details to sign off.
Devon Brooks: Confirmed — cloud provider allows burst-to-spot with reserved credits applied first; H100 reserved SKUs are in increments of 4 GPUs for the region, so exact mapping matters. I'll provide a sample invoice breakdown showing commit credits applied to hourly SKUs.
Anna Müller: I'll include an immediate mitigation plan for the cronjob + an estimate of retroactive egress charges and whether we can claim adjustment with support.
Olivia Chen: Great. Let's sync Tues 09:30 to walk the numbers. If anyone hits blockers preparing the doc, ping me. Also tagging :legal: for early heads-up. :raised_hands:
